caption: The drawing is rendered in black and white and features a depiction of an architectural structure. On the right side is a large, rectangular brick wall with a rounded top center, above which is a cross. The detailing suggests the wall is made of individual bricks, with some bricks shaded darker to create texture. On the left, a smaller section is attached, featuring a stone arch supported by a column. The arch creates a passageway through the wall. Below the illustration, there are handwritten labels in a ribbon-like style: the upper left ribbon says "1776", the central horizontal ribbon says "mission san juan capistrano", and the lower ribbon slightly to the right reads "end wall of chapel". The last ribbon is also signed "sjones" at the end. The entire composition is set against an off-white or beige background, with no other objects or embellishments.
title: Mision San Juan Capistrano - End of Chapel Wall
